recommended_model: Free supplier profile plus paid active equipment listings before any rental success fee.

supplier_profile.purpose: Let rental companies claim identity, branch, regions, contact routes, and proof readiness before paid listing activation.

phase_one.payment_rule: Buyer pays rental company directly. Heavyster collects listing SaaS only.

phase_one_expansion.yard_pack_timing: Offer private annual yard packs only after supplier onboarding, fleet import, and billing status are working.
phase_one_expansion.public_price_rule: Keep USD 9 monthly and USD 99 yearly per active listing as the public price anchor.

starter_pack_example.use_case: Founder-discretion annual close for verified rental yards with many machines.

phase_two.supplier_protection: Keep listing subscription separate and do not charge a booking fee without clear workflow value.

guardrails: No rental payment collection in phase one.
No escrow, deposit, or rental commission route in phase one.
Do not hide the simple per-listing price behind confusing packages.
Do not scale buyer traffic into markets where supply, proof, or response readiness is weak.
why_it_wins: Heavy equipment rental is operational and trust-heavy. Heavyster should first sell verified visibility, proof, freshness, and direct enquiries before becoming a transaction operator.
